answer: An agent economy resists Sybil attacks by making each identity lock its own stake inside a vault that is slashed the moment duplicate control is proved. To add one fake voice an attacker must post a fresh, independent deposit, so N clones demand N separate stakes held at once instead of one sum quietly reused. Every shared thread of funding or coordination leaves a trail, and a single proven link lets judges collapse the whole vine of accounts and forfeit every deposit, so scaling an attack only multiplies what the cheater stands to lose.
